status: Overseas department and region of France
name: French Guiana
blurb: Amazon rainforest, Europe's spaceport and the old penal colony of Devil's Island.
cities: The Creole capital, with markets, the Fort Cépérou view and Kaw marsh trips.
Rocket launches at the Guiana Space Centre and the penal-colony islands offshore.
The Transportation Camp prison and pirogue trips up the Maroni River.
